From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — Technical deep dive scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your ML + infra teams into a 60-90 minute technical deep dive:

Recap (from discovery):
- Primary use case: inference for near-real-time clinical summarization (sub-second tail important for UX).
- Expected QPS: 50-150 depending on rollout; bursty during morning syncs.
- Data constraints: patient PHI, plans for on-prem / VPC deployment in phase 2, SOC 2 scope required.

Proposed next step:
- 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML engineering and infra teams to cover: model selection / quantization options, latency SLOs and measurement, deployment topology (hosted vs dedicated vs private), KV/prefix caching, and audit/logging requirements.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed, Mar 2: 10:00-11:30 or 14:00-15:30
- Thu, Mar 3: 10:00-11:30 or 16:00-17:30

Please confirm which window works and who from your side will attend (ML lead, infra, security/compliance). I'll loop in our infra engineer Dylan and solutions engineer Camila to align the agenda.

Attaching a draft agenda for the deep dive (Acme_deep_dive_agenda.pdf). Also linking the HubSpot record for context: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-2321

Action items:
- Alex: confirm preferred date/time and attendees
- Marissa: once confirmed, send calendar invite + final agenda

Thanks — looking forward to digging in.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

A couple of asks for the agenda: please include a short section on data residency and audit logs (we need to understand how your Private deployment addresses log retention and who has access to audit trails). Also, can Dylan cover expected throughput with batching + caching (ballpark performance numbers) so we can size capacity?
